title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, now fully available and ready to empower your decision-making.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Experience superior control over your content with our newly designed file management system, allowing you to easily upload, organize, and customize the display of your images and documents.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a brand-new public roadmap page to give you a clear, real-time look at what's shipped, what's next, and what's planned for Noeko.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: Experience effortless task management with our enhanced checkboxes that are now easier to click, fully draggable, and beautifully integrated into our modern interface.

title: Seamless Collaboration Experience
summary: Enjoy a smoother, more intuitive collaboration experience with enhanced real-time updates that keep everyone perfectly in sync.

title: Seamless Sharing and Discovery
summary: Effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared items, empowering you to work more seamlessly with others on your ideas and quests.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's evolution.

title: Unlocking Global Communication
summary: Noeko is now expanding to support a comprehensive range of international languages, making our platform accessible to a worldwide audience.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Stunning Themes
summary: Experience a revitalized interface with an expanded selection of beautiful themes and significant improvements to your favorites.

title: Enhanced Knowledge Map for Deeper Discovery
summary: Transform your personal knowledge map into an invaluable workflow starter with powerful new filtering capabilities for tags, time, and shared items, enabling effortless exploration and connection.

title: Powerful Search Filters and Personalized Compendiums
summary: Uncover exactly what you need by applying advanced filters and sorting options, then effortlessly save your curated results into personalized Compendiums for future reference.

title: Flexible Note Layouts
summary: This feature introduces versatile display options for your notes, allowing you to intuitively organize and interact with your content for a more personal workspace.

title: Take Control: Noeko Self-Hosting and New Subscription Plans
summary: Experience ultimate flexibility with Noeko's upcoming self-hosting capability and a range of new subscription plans tailored to your team's needs.

title: Smarter Welcome Messages
